input_seal: Before fitting, append a separately committed manifest pinning numeric cost rows, availability checkpoint, eligibility evidence/exclusions and runner revision. That seal may record newly completed acquisition but must not change this objective, role membership, feature schema, hyperparameters, gates or selection rules. All trial attempts and failures remain recorded.
scope: Original16-coefficient claim head for the optional value of auxiliary file search, not raw text generation. Feature schema riido-path-claim-v1; no repository/task IDs, vocabulary, target ranks or label text in model inputs. Preserve full train7335/validation5686 coverage and final2402 protection. This is one search pilot; model up/down routing, decomposition, repo routing and real agent utility remain distinct requirements.
readiness: Require source-eligible scoreable train>=2400 and validation>=2400, with>=100 eligible scoreable tasks in each of5 validation repositories, before fitting or selecting a winner. Use policy41's local numeric scope and actual snapshot evidence/exceptions. Unknown permissions, missing catalogs and unsupported/blank/unmapped targets remain pending/excluded with reasons in full denominators; never relabel as negatives or move/replace tasks. This gate permits comparison, not a success claim.
objective: For each lambda in[0,0.25,1,4,16], delta=baseline_first_target_pages-helper_first_target_pages-lambda; target=1 if delta>0 else0; sample_weight=abs(delta)/5016. Page size20 and at most100000 candidates imply page counts<=5000 and abs(delta)<5016. Reject values outside these mathematical bounds; do not clip. Constant global scaling preserves the existing trainer's normalized weighted objective and keeps weights<=1, within its unchanged4096 validation limit. Keep zero-weight rows in coverage and record their count; require positive total weight.
fit: Use pairlearn.Fit with Dimension16, FP32 weights, weighted BCE, learning_rate0.1,L2=0.0001,max_epochs100,batch64. Seeds1729(primary) and2718(replication); both required, no favorable-seed selection. Five penalties times two seeds=10 FP32 candidates. Go CPU sequential ownership of contiguous arrays; no shared mutable training state or new locks. Implement a path-specific adapter rather than altering old2948/3009/three-repository experiment wrappers.
epoch: For each candidate, minimum validation weighted NLL chooses epoch; ties choose earliest epoch. Cost-weighted sigmoid is not a calibrated probability of success. Track all10 candidates and epoch traces including failures.
threshold: Validation is development selection data. Include disabled baseline as a candidate; helper cap90percent of eligible scoreable validation tasks. Group equal scores wholly, never split ties. Choose lowest validation total pages, then fewer auxiliary calls, then smaller lambda; deterministic remaining ties use higher threshold and earlier epoch. Do not use final for threshold/penalty/seed selection.
controls: On identical eligible rows, compare baseline-only, always-helper, zero-penalty learned head and a16-feature baseline-gap heuristic with the same90percent cap and validation-only threshold procedure. Report per-role/per-repository and equal-repository macro metrics, paired page gains/losses/ties, Hit1/10/100 and All10, actual call attempts/fallbacks and full coverage. Report benefit/harm scarcity as insufficient evidence rather than manufacturing samples.
pilot_usefulness_gate: Both seeds must reduce validation pages by>=5percent versus baseline and by>=1percent versus always-helper, while using<=90percent helper calls; pooled and equal-repository macro Hit10 may not decline versus baseline. No validation repository may worsen total pages by>5percent versus baseline. These are private pilot advancement gates, not production/final confirmation. If they fail, record the failure and do not rerun this same family with adaptive hyperparameter searches.
resources: Bound the input to32768 rows and16 finite[0,1] features, at most10 fits; use Go CPU, no GPU inference or upstream fine-tuning in this pilot. Target runner process RSS<=256MiB measured only in isolation; report exceedance without hiding work or dropping rows. Report model file bytes separately from decoded weight memory and complete pipeline costs. FP32 storage can still use float64 feature/scorer arithmetic, which must be disclosed.
artifact: Private16-weight JSON with feature schema, coefficient precision, actual input/eligibility/plan/runner hashes, threshold/lambda/seed/epoch and all trials. Reject wrong schema/length/nonfinite coefficients. Do not reuse2048-dimensional hintlearn.Encode. No weights in Git and no HF model publication before separate actual-input notices/license/artifact and quality/resource review.
confirmation: Keep all2402 final tasks unscored until a model, threshold, runner and input manifest are sealed and an adequate final acquisition/source review is separately planned. A viewed final set becomes observed regression evidence and cannot be reused as a fresh final after tuning. Repeated validation observations belong to the trial ledger.
next_utility: After useful FP32 signal, measure actual selected execution (helper skipped work), cold/warm end-to-end latency/RSS, context bytes or tokens, all required evidence and paired completed public tasks. Model routing must include failures and escalation costs; decomposition must include dependencies and final integration; repo routing needs separate ambiguous/none/cross-repo and64/256/1024-catalog tests. Page proxies and human difficulty labels alone cannot finish the full project goal.
ternary: Only after FP32 signal, separately precommit same-input FP32/INT8/ternary PTQ/ternary STE comparisons. Measure quality, stored bytes, latency/allocations/RSS separately. Tiny16-weight packing need not improve total runtime; shadow floating weights and actual arithmetic must be documented.
